Here are 5 distinct mate-in-1 scenarios for White, ranging from basic endgame patterns to piece-specific combinations.

```text
Scenario 1: The Back Rank Mate
6k1/5ppp/8/8/8/8/8/1R4K1 w - - 0 1
Rb8#
```

```text
Scenario 2: Smothered Mate (Knight)
6rk/6pp/8/4N3/8/8/8/7K w - - 0 1
Nf7#
```

```text
Scenario 3: The "Kiss of Death" (King & Queen)
4k3/8/4K3/2Q5/8/8/8/8 w - - 0 1
Qe7#
```

```text
Scenario 4: Arabian Mate (Rook & Knight)
7k/8/5N2/8/8/8/8/6R1 w - - 0 1
Rg8#
```

```text
Scenario 5: Long Diagonal Battery (Queen & Bishop)
6k1/p4ppp/5Q2/8/8/8/1B6/6K1 w - - 0 1
Qxg7#
```
